stances_toward.note: Adversary, cooling (worsening), confidence C. The new government treats the ELN as an enemy to be defeated, not a negotiating table: it ordered the first air strike of its term on ELN structures in Tibú and San Calixto on the night of 10 Aug 2026 (two fighters dead, three farmers wounded, per the army and the Defensoría), the president answered the criticism with 'with the narcoterrorists there is no truce' (headline of a local outlet), and a single outlet reports that as president-elect he declared the ELN and Frente 33 commanders 'military objectives' (not corroborated). Adversary rather than rival because the declared aim is the group's defeat or surrender, the Ecuador-gangs and Pakistan-TTP precedent in the atlas; the ELN's own stated aim is not re-read here. Cooling because Petro's own government had already bombed an ELN camp in May 2026 and warned the group in January, and the new line is harder still (no truce, no talks). Bond grievance: a long armed conflict, our reading. Gap: no source after 12 Aug 2026 on ELN operations.

A rebel attack on a military post in the same region on 5 Sep killed three soldiers.
